body.x: Score each agent's monthly KPI the same way every time, from evidence, so the number reflects real performance and survives review by the SPV or Department Head.
Monthly KPI scoring for Team B, on the Senior and Junior scorecards. Weights and bands are the rubric; this SOP governs the scoring process, not the rubric design.

x: **Change weights by rule, for everyone. Never edit a metric score to hit a target.** Lowering a correct score to reach a number is falsifying a record.
**Every score is evidence-backed.** No invented figures.
**One rubric per role.** The same weights and band cutoffs apply to all Seniors, and all Juniors.
**A raw on a threshold takes the band it meets, not the higher one.**

x: No score-tuning to a target; weights only, applied uniformly.
Every score evidence-backed; no invented figures.
The result must square with the band meaning in Section 4.
Current Senior scorecards use different weights per person; standardise to one Senior template and one Junior template.
The QA cutoff must be identical across people, or the metric is not comparable.
New staff on probation are scored for evaluation and coaching only. Entitlement to rev share / bonus / KPI incentive is gated on passing probation (see New Staff Incentive Eligibility SOP, 37).
